attributes.board_name: North Carolina Marriage and Family Therapy Licensure Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE that by title and content deals with MFT practice and therapeutic issues, ethics and MFT supervision (no Board pre-approval); live and online accepted; graduate courses (1 semester hour = 15 contact hours); ongoing supervision by an AAMFT approved supervisor/candidate up to 12 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: For the first renewal, hours count from the initial date of licensure; afterwards they must be earned July 1 – June 30 of each renewal year.
rules.audit_note: Renew online via LearningBuilder with verification of CE; rejected courses on audit may be replaced within 90 days. Keep certificates 3 years.

topics.who: All licensees: ethics in the provision of professional mental health services (MFT ethics)

rules.notes: Annual renewal. No limit on online vs in-person hours. Presenting/teaching max 5 hours. License expires July 1 if CE evidence not submitted. Board cites the rule text effective 7/1/2011.
